scope: Share wallpaper-driven ink across the whole top panel, calibrate each native menu as one glass surface, and retain known incoming menu titles during focus changes.
approval: The maintainer approved the local Tahoe and Golden Gate menu comparison and requested publication.

checks.command: Ran the native global-menu model, popup and QML composition cases plus the top-bar geometry test.

Built the applet and sampled panel ink in KDE neon Wayland. Switched between Finder, Dolphin and Kate, opened File, changed the wallpaper and the automatic day/night variant, and checked both ends of the bar.
Compared Tahoe and Golden Gate captures against their native macOS menu references and verified the shared material ink and selected-row text.
Checked the component installation fingerprint ledger.

coverage_limits: Visual and frame checks used one KDE neon Wayland output. The first activation of an unknown menu waits for its exporter.
